erin: Quick note  new onboarding users keep hitting 429s when they run the paginated quickstart with parallel workers. Looks like multiple issues around client-side throttling + auth retry interaction.
phil: Repro'd. When token refresh and retry backoff happen while a client holds a slot, the SDK sometimes keeps the slot marked as in-use across retries. So retries + backoff -> effective oversubscription.
anika: Oof. Is this the same leak we fixed last sprint?
erin: Related but different. That leak was a missing release on exception. This is an accounting bug: on retry we used to schedule retry without decrementing the in-flight counter first.
phil: Example simplified pattern users paste from quickstart:
```js
// naive
const pages = [];
for await (const p of paginator) pages.push(p);
await Promise.all(pages.map(p => process(p)));
```
This bursts everything at once. Combine with tokenBucket allowing short bursts and a retry that holds slots -> thundering herd.
anika: Two-pronged fix: 1) change quickstart to show a bounded concurrency pattern (await limiter.acquire(); try/finally release), 2) SDK: decrement counters on all retry/error paths and make release idempotent.
erin: Also add an opt-in backpressure helper in SDKs, e.g. `client.createLimiter({maxConcurrent, smoothingMs})` with acquire/release and a `wrap(fn)` helper for convenience. Docs should show both explicit try/finally and the wrapper.
phil: Auth edge: when auth refresh fails we must ensure any held slot is released immediately and any retries don't keep slots reserved while sleeping. Add a test where refresh fails 50% of the time mid-work.
anika: Telemetry: emit `client.inflight` gauges and `client.leak_detected` counter. Console should warn when inflight > max for >20s. That will help classifying leaks vs bursts.
erin: UX: quickstart patch should be hotfixed because lots of people copy/paste it. We'll add a bold note about production concurrency and link to the backpressure helper.
phil: I'll own the JS SDK patch: idempotent release + decrement-on-retry + limiter helper. Will add unit tests simulating 100 acquires with intermittent 429s and token refresh failures.
anika: I'll update quickstart and the docs. Also add a small migration note for users of the old naive pattern.
ops-bot: Ops: rolling deploy of fix/limiter branch to staging scheduled at 02:00 UTC.
ci-bot: CI: branch `fix/limiter` queued for tests.
erin: Once CI passes, cut a patch release and push a short onboarding note. This should reduce early support tickets and make the sample app safer to copy.
anika: Also add sample code for server-side polite retry (jitter/backoff) to discourage tight retry loops.
phil: Great. I'll open PR#790 (js-sdk) and tag here when ready.
ci-bot: CI: tests started for `fix/limiter`.
erin: Thanks team  small changes but big DX win.
